meta.name: handoff
meta.description: Compact the current conversation into a handoff document for another agent to pick up.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将当前对话压缩为交接文档，供其他智能体继续处理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个智能体之间传递对话上下文
copy.tagline_en: Compact the current conversation into a handoff document for another agent
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to pass conversation context between multiple agents

howto.what: 当你要把当前对话交给另一个 AI 继续处理时，Claude 会生成一份交接文档：总结对话内容、建议要用的技能，并保存到系统临时目录；还会脱敏敏感信息，不重复已有文件内容。
howto.when: 当你明确要求把当前对话整理成给另一个 AI 的交接文档，或说“生成交接文档”等类似指令时触发。

say.text: 把当前对话整理成交接文档，给另一个助手继续处理
say.note: Claude 会生成并保存交接文档

say.text: 生成交接文档，注明下次用途是客户需求分析
say.note: 你给的用途会成为文档重点

say.text: 总结对话，保存为交接文档，并建议下一步可用的技能
say.note: 文档会包含 suggested skills 区段

howto.what_en: When asked, Claude compacts the current conversation into a handoff document for a new agent, saves it to the OS temp directory, includes suggested skills, avoids duplicating existing artifacts, and redacts sensitive info.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly ask to package the current conversation into a handoff document for another agent to continue.

say_en.text: Turn this conversation into a handoff document for another assistant to continue.
say_en.note: Claude will generate and save it.

say_en.text: Create a handoff document and note the next focus is customer needs analysis.
say_en.note: Your stated purpose shapes the doc.

say_en.text: Summarize the conversation, save as handoff, and suggest skills to use next.
say_en.note: The doc will include a suggested skills section.
